hypothesis: The spread between original H.15 U.S. Treasury 10-year and 2-year constant-maturity yields reflects growth-duration/discount-rate conditions distinct from original Stage1 39 price/VIX inputs, failed HYG/LQD credit momentum and OFR funding stress. This probe tests source identity and clocks only, not sign or prediction.
request_rule: At most one GET per URL, exact listed order, <=30s, no mirror or fallback; retain every HTTP response/status/header/body including failures. Stop original-release qualification on any non-200 or missing 2-year/10-year row. Current-history DDP is ingestion/identity only, not a historical first-public version.
source_timing: Official H.15 current release page states daily 4:15 p.m. Eastern posting, except holidays/closure. Older 2011 original can state 2:30 p.m. Eastern; use only next actual Qlib session after the release date in any future feature. Exact historical receipt/revision must be checked separately.
acceptance: Three original release documents must identify H.15, release date, same-release 2-year and 10-year Treasury constant maturity values, and a nonfuture use date; current DDP must identify both series and daily coverage. No factor vector, label, fits, account, SOXX outcome reads or historical PIT claim from three anchors.
NAS_policy: Archive exact source bytes and sanitized response headers, record SHA-256, remote hash and scoped restore before any local source is disposable.
